title: Bank KYC update threat
description: Message claims your bank account, wallet or card will be blocked unless you update KYC immediately via a link or by calling a number.
examplePhrases: Your account will be blocked today. Update KYC now
Dear customer your KYC is expired click the link to avoid suspension
Complete PAN verification within 24 hours or account will be frozen
redFlags: Asks for card, PIN, OTP or net-banking login
whatToDo: Open your bank's official app or website yourself
Call the number printed on your debit card
Report on 1930 if you shared details

title: Fake 'receive money' collect request
description: Scammer sends a UPI collect request but says you must enter your PIN to receive money. Entering the PIN sends money out.
examplePhrases: Approve the request and enter your UPI PIN to receive Rs 5000
I have sent you money, accept the collect request to get it
Enter PIN to receive refund
redFlags: PIN is never needed to receive money
Stranger or buyer pushing you to approve
whatToDo: Never enter your UPI PIN to receive money
Block and report the UPI ID in your payment app

title: Fake police / CBI / customs video call
description: Caller poses as police, CBI, ED, NCB or customs, says you are linked to a crime or illegal parcel, keeps you on a video call and demands money to 'clear' your case.
examplePhrases: You are under digital arrest, do not disconnect the call
A parcel in your name contains drugs, CBI will arrest you
Transfer money to the RBI verification account to prove innocence
redFlags: No agency arrests or interrogates anyone over video call
Demand to stay on call and tell no one
Payment to a personal or 'safe' account
whatToDo: No agency demands money to close a case

title: Like-and-earn or task-based job offer
description: Offer of easy online income for liking videos or rating products. Small payouts build trust, then you are asked to deposit larger amounts for 'premium tasks'.
examplePhrases: Earn Rs 3000 daily by liking YouTube videos, no experience needed
Work from home part time, join our Telegram group
Complete the prepaid task to unlock your commission
redFlags: Contact via WhatsApp or Telegram from unknown number
Asks you to pay or deposit money
whatToDo: Stop all contact and leave the group

title: Instant loan with fee upfront or harassment
description: Instant loan messages that demand processing fees first, or apps that take contact and gallery access and later threaten borrowers with morphed images.
examplePhrases: Pre-approved loan Rs 50,000 in 5 minutes, pay Rs 999 processing fee
Install this app for instant loan without documents
Repay today or we will message all your contacts
redFlags: App asks for contacts, photos and SMS permission
whatToDo: Uninstall the app and revoke permissions

title: Power will be cut tonight
description: SMS says your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight due to unpaid bill and asks you to call an officer or install an app.
examplePhrases: Your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM, call the officer
Previous month bill not updated, contact 98XXXXXXXX immediately
Pay now using this link to avoid power cut
redFlags: Mobile number instead of official helpline
Request to install an app or pay through a link
whatToDo: Check your bill on the official board website or app
Never call the number in the SMS
Report to the electricity provider and 1930

title: You have won a prize
description: Claims you won a lottery, KBC prize, gift or lucky draw and asks for a fee, tax or personal details to release it.
examplePhrases: Congratulations you have won Rs 25 lakh in lucky draw
Pay Rs 5000 as GST to release your prize
Your mobile number was selected in KBC lottery
whatToDo: Never pay to receive a prize

title: Parcel stuck at customs
description: Fake courier or customs message says a parcel is held and asks for a fee, or transfers you to a fake officer.
examplePhrases: Your parcel is held at customs, pay clearance fee
FedEx: illegal items found in your package, press 1 to talk to officer
Delivery failed, update address and pay Rs 25 redelivery fee
redFlags: You are not expecting a parcel
Escalation to police or customs on call
whatToDo: Check tracking only on the courier's official site
Hang up on calls transferring you to officers

title: Caller pretending to be bank staff asks for OTP
description: Caller says there is a suspicious transaction or card upgrade and asks you to share OTP, CVV or PIN to 'cancel' or 'verify'.
examplePhrases: I am calling from your bank, share the OTP to stop the fraud transaction
Your card is being upgraded, tell me the 6 digit code
Read out the CVV to verify your identity
redFlags: Banks never ask for OTP, PIN or CVV
Caller already knows some of your details
whatToDo: Never share OTP, PIN or CVV
Call your bank using the number on your card
Block the card if details were shared and call 1930

title: Fake support number from a search engine or social post
description: Scammers publish fake helpline numbers for banks, e-commerce, delivery and wallets. Victims are told to install an app or share details for a refund.
examplePhrases: Call our toll free support to get your refund
Customer care will help you cancel the order, share your card details
Install this support app so we can fix your payment
redFlags: Number found via search or comment, not the official app
Asks for card or UPI details for refund
whatToDo: Use only helplines from the official app or website
Never install apps on a caller's instruction
Report fake listings to the platform

title: Scan this QR code to receive payment
description: Scammer sends a QR code on marketplace chats and claims scanning it will credit money. Scanning a payment QR and entering PIN debits your account.
examplePhrases: Scan this QR code to receive your payment
I will pay in advance, scan the QR and enter PIN
Scan to get cashback
redFlags: Receiving money never needs a QR scan with PIN
Buyer sends QR instead of asking your UPI ID
whatToDo: Share your UPI ID or QR only to receive
Report the account in the marketplace

title: Guaranteed returns via WhatsApp or Telegram group
description: Fake stock or IPO tips groups with fake profit screenshots. Victims deposit into a fake trading app that shows gains but blocks withdrawals.
examplePhrases: Join our VIP group for guaranteed 30 percent monthly returns
Invest through our app, IPO allotment assured
Pay tax to withdraw your profit
redFlags: App not in a regulated broker list
whatToDo: Check advisers on the SEBI website

title: Send crypto and receive double
description: Promises to multiply crypto or fiat, often with fake celebrity endorsement or fake exchange websites.
examplePhrases: Send 0.1 BTC and get 0.2 BTC back instantly
Celebrity giveaway, first 100 users get double
Our trading bot gives 5 percent daily

title: Recorded video call used for blackmail
description: A stranger starts an explicit video call, records it, then threatens to send it to your contacts unless you pay.
examplePhrases: Pay Rs 20000 or I will send your video to all your friends
We have recorded your video call
Delete will cost money, send now
redFlags: Attacker shares your contact list screenshots
whatToDo: Do not pay, payment leads to more demands
Do not delete chats, take screenshots

title: Link or update your Aadhaar or PAN now
description: Messages claim PAN will be deactivated or Aadhaar needs updating, with a link to a lookalike government site that steals details.
examplePhrases: Your PAN will be deactivated, update immediately
Aadhaar verification pending, click here
Link your PAN with bank account to avoid penalty
redFlags: Link not on a gov.in domain
Asks for bank login or OTP
whatToDo: Visit the official government portal by typing the address yourself
Lock biometrics if you suspect misuse

title: Refund approved, submit bank details
description: Fake tax department message says a refund is approved and asks you to enter card or bank details on a lookalike page.
examplePhrases: Income tax refund of Rs 15,490 approved, click to claim
Submit account number to receive your refund
Refund will lapse in 24 hours
redFlags: Refunds are credited to the account on your return, not claimed via link
whatToDo: Check refund status on the official e-filing portal
Report phishing to the tax department

title: Online partner asks for money or investment
description: A friendly stranger builds trust over weeks, then asks for emergency money, gifts, customs fees or investment in a platform.
examplePhrases: I sent you a gift but customs needs a fee
I am stuck abroad, please send money, I will repay
Let me show you a platform where I make big profit
whatToDo: Do not send money to someone you have not met

title: Install this .apk to claim a scheme, challan or reward
description: WhatsApp message with an .apk file or link claims to be a government scheme, bank rewards or an invitation. The app steals SMS and OTPs.
examplePhrases: Download PM Kisan App apk to get your payment
Wedding invitation.apk
Install bank rewards app to redeem points
redFlags: Installing from outside the official store
App requests SMS and accessibility permission
whatToDo: If installed, disconnect internet, uninstall and change passwords from another device
Contact your bank to block cards

title: Pending traffic fine, pay now
description: SMS says a traffic challan is pending and asks you to pay through a link or APK to avoid higher penalty.
examplePhrases: Pending traffic challan, pay now to avoid court notice
Vehicle fine of Rs 500, pay at the link
Your RC will be suspended
redFlags: Link not on the official parivahan.gov.in site
No challan number or vehicle number details
whatToDo: Check challans on the official transport portal

title: Install AnyDesk or TeamViewer to fix or refund
description: Caller asks you to install a screen sharing app to fix a problem or process a refund, then drains your accounts while viewing your screen.
examplePhrases: Install AnyDesk and tell me the 9 digit code
Share your screen so I can process the refund
Download QuickSupport to fix your account
redFlags: Caller wants control of your device
Refund process asks to open banking apps
whatToDo: Do not install or share the code
If done, disconnect internet and uninstall at once
Change banking passwords from another device

title: Your number will be disconnected
description: Caller or SMS claims to be from the telecom regulator or provider, says your number is involved in illegal activity or KYC is pending and will be blocked.
examplePhrases: Your SIM will be blocked in 2 hours, press 9
TRAI notice: illegal messages sent from your number
Complete SIM KYC or the number will be disconnected
redFlags: Automated call asking to press a key
whatToDo: Contact your telecom provider through its official app
Report at the Sanchar Saathi portal

title: Buyer or seller pays advance via QR, claims to be in the army
description: On OLX or Facebook Marketplace, a fake army or CRPF person asks you to scan QR or pay a small advance to 'verify' before delivery or purchase.
examplePhrases: I am army officer, will pay advance, scan this QR
Pay Rs 1 to verify your account then I pay full
My transport will pick up, send token advance
redFlags: Refuses to meet or pay on delivery
whatToDo: Meet in person and pay or receive on delivery

title: Free laptop, subsidy or scheme registration fee
description: Messages about free laptops, scholarships, gas subsidy or cash benefit ask for registration fee or personal and bank details through unofficial sites.
examplePhrases: Register now to get free laptop under government scheme
Pay Rs 299 registration to receive subsidy
Share Aadhaar and bank details to get your benefit
redFlags: Fee for a free government benefit

title: I sent money by mistake, please return
description: Scammer sends a small amount, then calls claiming it was a mistake and asks you to send it back, sometimes via a collect request or a fake bank-credit SMS.
examplePhrases: I sent Rs 5000 to your number by mistake, return it
Please refund, I will go to the police otherwise
Check your account and send it back to this UPI ID
redFlags: Credit confirmation only via SMS screenshot
Request to send to a different account
whatToDo: Check your actual bank balance in the official app
Ask them to go through their bank for a dispute
Do not send to a different account

title: Hi it's me, new number, need urgent money
description: Message from an unknown number pretends to be a relative, boss or friend with an urgent emergency and asks for immediate payment. Voice cloning can make calls convincing.
examplePhrases: Hi mom this is my new number, please send Rs 15000 urgently
I am in hospital, can't talk, send money to this account
Boss here, buy gift cards urgently and send me the codes
redFlags: Money request to a third-party account
whatToDo: Call the person on their old number
Ask a question only they would know
